payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

decision.question: Compared with the source, has the image been transformed into a coherent chalk drawing, with drawing-like rendering replacing substantial photographic structure in both the subjects and the background?
decision.criteria: Pass only when the main subjects and surrounding scene are rendered as a coherent chalk-made drawing: drawing-like forms and chalk marks replace substantial source-like photographic anatomy, patterns, and scene detail in both subjects and background. Fail when there is no meaningful chalk-drawing treatment, or when chalk-like grain, softened outlines, smudging, or shading is visible but substantial photographic structure or detail remains in either the subjects or background. Texture, scene-wide coverage, or recognizable chalk effects alone do not establish completion. Unknown if the source or edited image is unavailable or evidence is insufficient to judge.
decision.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Explicitly assess residual source-like photographic structure separately in the subjects and the background, as well as whether drawing-like forms and chalk rendering replace it. Do not infer completion from texture or coverage alone. Judge the requested chalk-medium transformation, not a particular style.
